correctness.rationale: For every stated n, p, W and initialization, Ws=(1-2p)s gives exact full-to-scalar reduction. Inward boundary signs and logistic invariance secure global positive solutions. The leadership coordinate is strictly monotone off rho=4p^2 and its limiting value must be a boundary by stable forced linear ODE. Above threshold y tends to 1 exponentially and opinion returns to its anchor; at threshold y is constant and opinion has an explicit exponential solution. Below threshold y,u tend to 0, u/y tends to a/(2p) by the stable ratio equation, and d(y^-2)/dt tends to 2(4p^2-rho)a^2/(4p^2), yielding exact positive square-root limits. value.rationale: The source introduces a socially motivated competition between squared individual conviction and squared disagreement. How network mixing fixes the eventual leadership role is a genuine model-level mathematical gap; the proved sharp rho=4p^2 boundary works on every finite directed, unequal-sized equitable two-community network and distinguishes full leader recovery, partial leadership persistence, and complete follower emergence. The universal t^(-1/2) amplitude quantifies critical slowing and shows exactly which details of initial state and network disappear from asymptotic decay. The exact symmetric scope is natural but intentionally narrower than arbitrary-network global attraction; it is not a table recomputation or isolated numeric special case.
